notes.title: TEAM RISE 1.1.4 - New map, Boombox and bugfix !
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone ![/b]

And happy new year :)

At the start of this new year, I'm bringing you an update for Team Rise.
It's been over a year without an update, and I thought it was a shame to let this game lag behind my other projects. I'm pleased to offer you this update, which fixes many of the bugs that have been reported to me. It also brings a [u][b]new map : Atlantis ![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328759/58947e69c88f9b32590483537a81cba1efb3ac22.jpg[/img]

This map is much more complete than the first, and also features a new difficulty level (higher than the old one). It is, however, a little smaller than the first. (18% smaller)
I've also added a new item: a boombox ! You can take it with you and listen to the music it contains. Several are hidden on each level. Try to find them all !

Finally, many other invisible changes have been made, including a new netcode and a new loading system for multiplayer and single-player maps.
This will serve as a basis for future (free!) game updates.
In fact, I'm planning to add new game modes, less difficult and more fun! Like a “horror” mode and a mode inspired by the minecraft game “The Dropper”!

I hope you enjoy this update, and if you find any other bugs, don't hesitate to let me know here: support@homyrest.com
Being the only developer behind the game, it's hard for me to find bugs and test the game on different types of hardware.
~ Jeanbon

PS: I've also released a small DLC for $1.99, which includes a few cosmetics ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328759/b8190c4755d44403c20c38ef4aaf7a376fc7ee15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328759/16e6e8bfbecff2f5f08a9ad9779641cbf843efa8.jpg[/img]

Changelog : 

- New map : Atlantis
- New Item : Boombox (45 New Tracks, Lofi, Electro...)
- New map transition
- New lobby feature : Character Customization
- New Respawn button
- New logo
- New Credits page
- New netcode (Online subsystem update, steam API update)
- New translation : Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, French
- Bugfix : No crash on map load
- Bugfix : Replication error on mouvment
- Bugfix : Spawn point error
- Bugfix : Screen flashing on startup
- Bugfix : Jump animation in reverse
- Bugfix : Unable to invite people 
- Bugfix : Default screen resolution reseting in 4:3
- Bugfix : Crash on game load with low end hardware
- Bugfix : Achievement not unlocking in multiplayer
- Bugfix : Player list not adding player on join
- Bugfix : Winboard update
- And more little tweaks ;)
